summary: Backend testing of MSSP-report-driven self-learning KB feature. All 5 scenarios from the review request passed: meaningful edit ingests analyst_feedback KB row + vector-retrievable via /api/kb/search; trivial edit does not ingest; /close (no edit) increments accurate_confirmations without KB row; /action approve (no edit) increments confirmations without KB row; edit-then-close does NOT double count as confirmation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1624 lines — consider splitting KB / offense / auth routes into separate modules.
_ingest_analyst_feedback uses asyncio.create_task (fire-and-forget) with no retry; on failure the KB entry stays FAILED. Consider a background retry queue.

PATCH /mssp-report ingests on every meaningful edit, so successive edits create multiple feedback KB rows for the same offense. May want to update-in-place or dedupe by offense_id to keep tenant KB clean.
_mssp_meaningful_diff treats analyst_notes with <10 chars as non-meaningful but any recommendations/verdict/custom_fields/analysis_lines diff triggers ingestion — good coverage of user choice #4.
seed_data_creation: Used pre-seeded ACME offenses. Test run created 1 new analyst_feedback KB row and mutated 4 ACME offenses (2 investigated+edited, 2 investigated+closed/approved).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is working end-to-end. Vector RAG (chromadb + sentence-transformers) is functional in this env — kb/search returns 'feedback-' sourced matches. Note: tests use pytest-xdist by default via pytest.ini; run with -o addopts='' to disable parallel workers since scenarios share state via pytest module attrs.
